verdict: Organic activity is live, but the Google listing's call button is broken.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile generated 93 impressions and 79 direction requests, but zero calls — the call button or its tracking is confirmed broken at the listing level, and that is being fixed now. No paid campaigns are running this period; eight setup milestones that must be completed before ads can launch are overdue, and clearing those is the current priority. Eight contacts entered your pipeline organically this period, but none progressed to an appointment, pointing to a gap in intake or follow-up that is being reviewed alongside the pipeline setup. Website sessions are also trending down over the past 28 days, which reinforces the urgency of getting the full stack live. Once the overdue milestones are cleared, paid campaigns and proper attribution can switch on and pipeline movement should follow.
